work_1.title: Software Developer
work_1.paragraph_1: I was part of the team at Amber, the Uruguayan investment platform, and at Guesty, an Israeli property management system with thousands of employees around the world. I also built Fatsack, a mobile application, along with e-commerce sites and management platforms.
work_1.paragraph_2: I implemented integrations with payment gateways and services such as AWS, Firebase and social media platforms, working alongside design and development teams on multinational products.

work_2.title: Software Developer
work_2.paragraph_1: I contributed to the development of an electronic invoicing system for Paraguay, built on the .NET ecosystem.
work_2.paragraph_2: This full stack role included setting up continuous integration with Azure Pipelines and working directly with clients to resolve questions and issues.

proj_1.description: Led a team to create a blog showcasing the high-quality handicrafts of Uruguay. This portal was commissioned by the Uruguayan government and successfully positioned the website at the top of Google search results.

proj_2.description: Created a brand and landing page for a Uruguayan metallurgy company. Utilizing advanced SEO techniques, successfully positioned the website among the top Google search results, resulting in a 250% increase in client volume.

proj_3.description: Full stack E-commerce project replicating the Tesla store. This project was completed as part of the DevTalles Next.js course.

about.title: About me
about.subtitle: Tony, to my friends
about.paragraph_1: My name is Anthony Pastor, but my friends call me Tony. I started programming when I entered university and have been developing my skills as a Full Stack developer ever since.
about.paragraph_2: Over the last few years I have worked mostly in fintech and management platforms: investments, electronic invoicing, property management. I have also led development teams for Uruguayan government websites and worked at multinational companies.
about.paragraph_3: Fintech is where I feel most at home, but I am open to other products. I studied music for several years and I love ball sports. In my free time I play chess and read books.
about.fun_fact: Fun fact: I love french fries 🍟
